# ShadowFlix (FlixWatch) Comprehensive Entity Index
# This file is for AI agents to understand the site's structure and core entities.

## Main Nav
- Home: https://shadowflix.pro/
- Movies: https://shadowflix.pro/movie
- TV Shows: https://shadowflix.pro/tv
- Guides: https://shadowflix.pro/guides

## Legal & Trust
- Privacy: https://shadowflix.pro/legal/privacy-policy
- Terms: https://shadowflix.pro/legal/terms-of-service
- DMCA: https://shadowflix.pro/legal/dmca

## Content Architecture
ShadowFlix uses a hub-and-spoke model. 
- Movie Spokes: /movie/{slug}-{tmdb_id}
- TV Spokes: /tv/{slug}-{tmdb_id}
- Genre Hubs: /genre/{name}-{genre_id}
- Year Hubs: /year/{year}
- Country Hubs: /country/{iso_code}

## Data Standards
All content is sourced from TMDB API. We provide real-time metadata, trailers, and streaming guides for the US market.
